name: Sam Altman
title: CEO, OpenAI
biography: Entrepreneur and investor who led Y Combinator before becoming chief executive of OpenAI. Publicly associated with the commercialization of ChatGPT and the company's shift from a nonprofit research lab to a capped-profit frontier lab.
researchContributions: Scaled deployment of conversational frontier models
Public advocacy for compute governance and safety regulation

timeline.title: President of Y Combinator
timeline.description: Took over leadership of the seed accelerator.

timeline.title: Became OpenAI CEO
